entities.name: Intra MME handover
entities.description: Handover procedure where the MME remains the same but the UE moves between eNodeBs within the same MME coverage.

entities.name: Inter-eNodeB connected mode mobility
entities.description: Mobility procedure where the UE moves between eNodeBs while remaining in connected mode, with the MME unchanged.

entities.name: ESM NAS message
entities.description: A NAS message belonging to the EPS Session Management (ESM) protocol used for session management procedures.

entities.name: Lower layer indication of non-delivered NAS PDU
entities.description: Condition where the lower layers indicate that a NAS PDU could not be delivered to the UE.

entities.name: S1 signalling connection exists
entities.description: Condition indicating that the S1 signalling connection between the eNodeB and MME is still active.

entities.name: Target TA included in TAI list
entities.description: Condition where the target tracking area is present in the UE's TAI list.

entities.name: MME retransmission of ESM message
entities.description: Behavior where the MME retransmits a downlink ESM NAS message that could not be delivered.

relations.description: Non-delivery indication occurs due to intra MME handover.
Non-delivery indication occurs due to inter-eNodeB connected mode mobility.
Non-delivery of ESM message establishes the need for MME retransmission under certain conditions.
Retransmission occurs if the target TA is in the TAI list after successful intra MME handover.
Retransmission occurs if the S1 signalling connection exists after handover/mobility failure.
